sans.$description: Default working UI typeface for this template. Inter is a placeholder, same status as blue for color — a future consuming product may swap this stack and remap semantic text roles without touching component code.

mono.$description: Code/data typeface — inline code, IDs, tabular/numeric values.

xs.$description: 12px. Captions/labels only — never primary reading content.

md.$description: 16px. Base body size — the floor for primary reading content.

4xl.$description: 36px. Largest step in this scale — no editorial/marketing display sizes.

normal.$description: Unitless ratio. Body/UI text — matches WCAG 1.4.8's recommended paragraph line-height.

tight.$description: Large headings only — modest by design, never applied to body/label/caption sizes.
